feature.label: KNIME Geospatial File I/O (Java)
feature.description: Java-based KNIME nodes for reading and writing geospatial file formats (Shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoParquet, GML, GeoPackage), interoperable with the Python-based Geospatial Analytics Extension's geometry columns.
